diagrams.title: Event-driven XML processing
diagrams.label: XML transformation pipeline: RabbitMQ queues, routing, XSLT transformation and failure handling
diagrams.summary: Messages are routed and transformed asynchronously. Plugins extend the transformation without restarting the service.

components.title: Upstream systems
components.detail: Send XML requests through RabbitMQ
components.role: Producers of XML requests.

components.title: Request queue
components.detail: Messages wait until a worker takes them
components.role: Decouples producers from processing; messages are not processed inline.

components.title: Router
components.detail: Picks the destination queue per message
components.role: Routing is a separate step, so it can change without touching transformations.

components.title: XSLT transformer
components.detail: XSLT (Saxon) with Java extension functions
components.role: Transforms the message. Each plugin jar has its own classloader.

components.title: Destination queues
components.detail: Transformed messages are passed on
components.role: Delivery to the consuming systems.

components.title: Failure path
components.detail: Failed messages are kept, not dropped
components.role: Failure handling: a message that cannot be processed is not lost.

diagrams.title: Secure document delivery and distributed background processing
diagrams.label: Document link flow: link service, database, background downloader, local file store and stateless gateway
diagrams.summary: Time-limited, encrypted links let a gateway serve documents without a lookup. Background jobs keep the local store in step with link lifetimes.

components.title: Business application
components.detail: Requests a time-limited link to a document
components.role: The caller; it never receives the remote document location.

components.title: Link service
components.detail: Issues AES-GCM links with their own expiry
components.role: Creates links. The expiry is part of the encrypted link.

components.title: PostgreSQL
components.detail: Stores link records
components.role: The record of issued links, used by background jobs.

components.title: Background downloader
components.detail: Fetches the document into the local store
components.role: Runs outside the request path.

components.title: Local file store
components.detail: Holds documents until their links expire
components.role: The cache that background jobs keep consistent.

components.title: Link gateway
components.detail: Decrypts the link and streams the document
components.role: Stateless: it validates the link itself and needs no database lookup.

components.title: Scheduled jobs
components.detail: Remove expired documents on each scheduler
components.role: Keep the cache consistent with link lifetimes.

diagrams.title: Semantic search and MCP integration
diagrams.label: Messenger archive: sync, transcription, Qdrant index and MCP search
diagrams.summary: A personal project. Sync, transcription and indexing run as separate workers, and an MCP server exposes search to LLM agents.

components.title: Messenger account
components.detail: History is fetched over the MTProto API
components.role: The source of messages.

components.title: Sync service (Rust)
components.detail: Backs off on flood-wait; bounded retries
components.role: Writes messages and chats to PostgreSQL.

components.title: PostgreSQL
components.detail: Messages, chats and the transcription queue
components.role: The system of record for the archive.

components.title: Transcription worker (Python)
components.detail: Claims rows with SKIP LOCKED; runs Whisper
components.role: Lets several workers share one queue.

components.title: Indexer (Rust)
components.detail: Batched embeddings; checkpoint after upserts
components.role: Builds the vector index.

components.title: Qdrant
components.detail: Vectors with deterministic UUIDv5 point IDs
components.role: Stores embeddings; the same message always maps to the same point.

components.title: MCP server
components.detail: Search over stdio and HTTP for LLM agents
components.role: The interface for LLM agents.

concepts.title: Idempotency
concepts.text: Repeating an operation leaves the same result. Deterministic UUIDv5 point IDs mean a retried index step overwrites the same points instead of creating duplicates.

concepts.title: Eventual consistency
concepts.text: No single transaction spans PostgreSQL, Qdrant and the checkpoint. The systems converge because each write can be retried safely.

concepts.title: Message delivery guarantees
concepts.text: A message that fails is kept for handling, not dropped. A retry can deliver the same message twice, so consumers must be idempotent.

concepts.title: Failure handling
concepts.text: Failures are handled on purpose: rate limits trigger backoff, retries are bounded, and failed messages have their own path.

concepts.title: Distributed coordination
concepts.text: Workers coordinate through the database instead of a central scheduler. SKIP LOCKED lets several transcription workers share one queue without taking the same row twice. Several schedulers keep the document cache consistent.

concepts.title: Cache consistency
concepts.text: The local document store follows link lifetimes, so cached files are removed when the links that need them expire.

concepts.title: Observability
concepts.text: Operations need metrics and checks. The public Telegram automation toolkit exports Prometheus metrics for its CLI commands and includes an HTTP benchmark and a site availability monitor.

concepts.title: Security
concepts.text: Document links are AES-GCM encrypted and time-limited. The gateway checks the link itself, so access ends at the expiry time that the link carries.
